description: Parking_Enforcement_Areas is a dataset listed in City of Gainesville open data portal (data.cityofgainesville.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Gainesville. This dataset contains parking enforement areas for the city of gainesville. Parking within these areas are restricted and usually require neighborhood parking decals during partiular hours of the day. Coverage: Gainesville, Florida. The portal files it under the category Geospatial (Maps). Its tags are areas, parking, enforcement. The table has 3 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Gainesville Public Works. The portal shows 2013-11-07 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofgainesville-org-portal.
